experiences.title: Unified XUL Platform Contributor (C++ Developer)
points: Adapted and ported JS and CSS web features from Firefox, enhancing compatibility and functionality, which significantly improved cross-browser performance and user satisfaction.
Developed a custom implementation of a CSS selector from scratch, effectively resolving display issues encountered by end-users across multiple websites, leading to a more consistent user experience.
Conducted thorough research on legacy code to understand its complexities, ensuring seamless integration with new features and enhancing overall system performance and maintainability.
Reviewed submissions made by extension and theme developers to the Pale Moon Add-ons Site, ensuring adherence to quality standards and compatibility with the browser.
Addressed issues and reviewed pull requests related to the browser's layout component, contributing to improved layout stability and a reduction in user-reported layout bugs.

experiences.title: Chairperson
points: Provided leadership and direction for the Alliance’s programs, initiatives, and projects addressing the welfare and interests of dormitory residents across UPLB.
Represented the Alliance in discussions with university administration, presenting residents’ concerns and contributing to conversations on policies and resources related to student housing.

Communicated regularly with the UPLB Office of Student Housing, UPLB University Planning and Maintenance Office, UPLB Digital Innovation Center, UPLB Office of the Chancellor, and other relevant university offices regarding facility maintenance, internet connectivity, and other campus-provided services.
Led the PasADAhan 2026 Steering Committee, working with university offices, student organizations, and all residence hall associations.

Spearheaded the inaugural Tinig Dormer and Likhang Dormer events for PasADAhan 2026, providing residents with opportunities to showcase their talents in singing, spoken word poetry, photography, digital art, and traditional art.
Contributed to drafting a unified constitution for the Alliance and its member residence hall associations.

Facilitated the creation of Facebook groups for current and alumni residents, revived the ADA CARES form for reporting student housing concerns, and developed public guides on residential life, including reservations, payments, and connecting to eduroam and UPLB-Secure.

experiences.title: Ex officio member (as RHA President)
points: Represented the UPLB ATI-NTC Residence Hall Association in the Alliance of Dormitory Associations, contributing to discussions and decisions on matters affecting dormitory residents.

experiences.title: President
points: Led the development of Hall Association One (HAOne), a residence hall association management system designed to support day-to-day operations, resident records, and financial accounting.
Partnered with residents and association officers to plan and execute engaging community events and projects.

Facilitated communication and coordination to address residents' concerns regarding their experiences in the dormitory with the dormitory manager, the Office of Student Housing, the UPLB Alliance of Dormitory Associations, and the UPLB University Student Council.
Developed a financial tracking spreadsheet for budget management, receipt organization, and event reminders, facilitated e-mail communications.
Deployed a Windows-based print server, significantly improving printing accessibility and efficiency for residents.
Designed posters and promotional materials, resulting in increased event attendance and participation from both residents and non-residents.
Managed social media platforms and handled livestreaming for gaming and social events, fostering online community engagement.

experiences.title: Creatives Head
points: Designed the main poster for the annual Open House and related promotional materials.
Coordinated with the members of the creatives team to ensure that all event materials are produced on time.
